verdict.rationale: Recruitee lists a 'Reporting & Insights' feature and documents a bearer-token REST API with an endpoint that returns the company's candidates, so some data can be pulled out programmatically. Neither is shown to be a custom report builder or a dedicated reporting or analytics API. Missing for 10: evidence of custom report building, scheduled exports, BI connectors, a documented reporting/analytics API or warehouse sync, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: Calling this endpoint will return a collection of the company's candidates.
a client (any application that would like to use the API) needs to authenticate first with a header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
